title: Equivalent fractions
subtitle: Explore the idea with a visual model.
learning_objective: Recognize and create fractions with the same value.

sections.heading: Make sense of it
sections.body: Equivalent fractions use different-sized pieces to show the same amount. Multiply or divide the numerator and denominator by the same nonzero number.

sections.heading: Build a picture
sections.caption: Each row represents the same-sized whole.

steps: Split each half into two equal smaller parts.
One selected half becomes two selected fourths.
sections.reasoning: Each step keeps the meaning of the whole and its equal parts clear.

sections.heading: Watch for this
sections.body: Changing only the numerator or only the denominator changes the value.

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.hint: Use the visual and the worked steps above before choosing.
